career_paths.title: Customer service → CRM / operations
career_paths.reasoning: Customer service experience transfers cleanly into coordination and CRM roles. Move toward reporting and data step by step instead of jumping straight to analyst titles.

career_paths.title: Sales → account management / marketing automation
career_paths.reasoning: Sales experience is in steady demand. Add structured tools (CRM, reporting) to move from selling into account management and marketing operations.

career_paths.title: Admin → reporting / operations / data
career_paths.reasoning: Admin experience is the most flexible base. Reporting and operations roles are reachable with Excel and basic SQL; full analyst roles come later, not first.

career_paths.title: IT / tech → specialist tracks
career_paths.reasoning: IT demand is strong but the senior and security tracks are crowded. Enter through support, test, or junior developer roles and specialise from there.

career_paths.title: Healthcare → care / nursing track
realistic_now_roles: Undersköterskor, hemtjänst, hemsjukvård, äldreboende och habilitering
career_paths.reasoning: Care demand is high and entry-friendly. Licensed nurse and doctor roles require Swedish credentials, so treat them as study targets, not immediate applications.

career_paths.title: Education → teaching / pedagogy
career_paths.reasoning: Assistant and substitute roles are reachable now. Qualified teacher roles need a Swedish teaching licence, so plan study before targeting them.

career_paths.title: Restaurant / service → hospitality coordination
career_paths.reasoning: Service experience transfers into any customer-facing role. Use it to move toward coordination and customer success rather than chasing chef or manager titles first.

career_paths.title: Logistics / warehouse → operations / supply coordination
career_paths.reasoning: Warehouse and transport roles are widely available now. Add a forklift licence and Excel to move into coordination and planning roles.

career_paths.title: No clear experience → entry-friendly roles
career_paths.reasoning: Start with roles that have strong entry-level access and high volume. Build a track record, then move toward coordination or specialist routes with study.
